result.instructions: Tools for KASSA.AT, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which articles do we sell, and what do they cost including VAT?"; "Find the customer with number K-0042 and show their contact details."; "How much stock is left for article ART001 in the main warehouse?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes KASSA.AT data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kassa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kassa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kassa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kassa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kassa_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List the articles (products and services) of the cash register, with price, VAT percent, unit and bar codes. Full-text search with query, or filter by article number, bar code or your own article id. GET /api/v1/articles.

query.description: Full-text search over the article fields.

company_article_id.description: Your own article number (number, or an operator as in the docs).

sort.description: Sort field and direction, as the KASSA.AT docs show.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, for example id,line_item_name.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Use together with limit.

tools.name: kassa_list_article_categories
tools.title: List article categories
tools.description: List the product categories an article belongs to (id, name, colour). GET /api/v1/articles/{id}/product_categories.

tools.name: kassa_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, with name, customer number, address, phone and email. Full-text search with query, or filter by a field. GET /api/v1/customers.

query.description: Full-text search over the customer fields.

company_name.description: Company name (exact filter as the docs show).

sort.description: Sort field and direction, as the KASSA.AT docs show.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, for example id,line_item_name.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Use together with limit.

tools.name: kassa_find_customer_by_number
tools.title: Find a customer by number
tools.description: Find one customer by the customer number you assigned. GET /api/v1/customers/customer_number.

tools.name: kassa_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (stock locations) of the company, with id and description. GET /api/v1/warehouses.

deleted.description: true = only deleted warehouses, false = only active ones. Leave out for both.

tools.name: kassa_list_inventories
tools.title: List inventories (stock per article)
tools.description: List the inventory records of a warehouse for given articles, optionally with the current stock. Rate limited by KASSA.AT. Give article_numbers (up to 1000), article_number or article. POST /api/v1/warehouses/{id}/inventories/search (a read).

active.description: true = only active inventories, false = only inactive.

inspect_stock.description: true = include the current stock in each record.

tools.name: kassa_get_inventory_stock
tools.title: Get current stock
tools.description: Get the current stock quantity of one inventory record. GET /api/v1/warehouses/{id}/inventories/{inventory_id}/stock.

tools.name: kassa_create_article
tools.title: Create an article
tools.description: Create a new article (product or service) in the cash register. The VAT percent must be 0, 10, 13 or 20. Creates a record; it does not delete anything. POST /api/v1/articles.

manual_gross_amount_entry.description: Let the cashier enter the price by hand.

manual_quantity_entry.description: Let the cashier enter the quantity by hand.

tools.name: kassa_update_article
tools.title: Update an article
tools.description: Change one or more fields of an article. Only the fields you pass change; the rest stay as they are. PATCH /api/v1/articles/{id}.

manual_gross_amount_entry.description: Let the cashier enter the price by hand.

manual_quantity_entry.description: Let the cashier enter the quantity by hand.

tools.name: kassa_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Give at least one field. Creates a record; it does not delete anything. POST /api/v1/customers.

customer_number.description: Your customer number. An existing customer with this number is reused.

tools.name: kassa_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Change one or more fields of a customer. Only the fields you pass change. This tool does not delete customers. PATCH /api/v1/customers/{id}.

customer_number.description: Your customer number. An existing customer with this number is reused.

tools.name: kassa_record_stock_movement
tools.title: Record a stock movement
tools.description: Add a stock movement to one inventory: a positive quantity adds stock, a negative one removes it. It changes the stock level; it does not set an absolute level. POST /api/v1/warehouses/{id}/inventories/{inventory_id}/movements.

quantity.description: Positive = stock in, negative = stock out.

text.description: Short note for the movement (under 100 characters).

type.description: Force the direction. Leave out to use the sign of quantity.
